description: claude-sync session capture hooks: record the git HEAD at session start and append a session activity log (commits + uncommitted files) to per-project memory at session end.

hooks.command: sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$sid" ] && exit 0; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$root" ] && exit 0; d="$HOME/.claude/.session-state"; mkdir -p "$d"; f="$d/$sid"; [ -f "$f" ] && exit 0; git rev-parse HEAD > "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$root" ] && exit 0; proj=$(printf %s "$root" | sed 's|/|-|g'); state="$HOME/.claude/.session-state/$sid"; startsha=$(cat "$state" 2>/dev/null); commits=""; [ -n "$startsha" ] && commits=$(git log --oneline "$startsha"..HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -20); worktree=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u | sed '/^$/d' | head -20); if [ -z "$commits" ] && [ -z "$worktree" ]; then rm -f "$state"; exit 0; fi; dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$proj/memory"; mkdir -p "$dir"; log="$dir/session-log.md"; branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); { echo ""; echo "## Session $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"; [ -n "$branch" ] && echo "- Branch: $branch"; if [ -n "$commits" ]; then echo "- Commits:"; echo "$commits" | sed 's/^/    - /'; fi; if [ -n "$worktree" ]; then echo "- Uncommitted: $(printf %s "$worktree" | paste -sd, -)"; fi; } >> "$log"; rm -f "$state"; exit 0
